title: IdentityComparison
description: The result of compareRelationIdentity. RULE: if any identity-relevant qualifier is `unknown`, the decision MUST NOT be `equivalent` — it is `unresolved`, and `blockingDimensions` names the offending dimensions (see spec/03).

decision.description: equivalent (merge-compatible), distinct (differ on an identity dimension), or unresolved (blocked by an unknown identity-relevant qualifier).

blockingDimensions.description: Identity-relevant qualifier dimensions that block an `equivalent` decision (unknown or differing).
